title: Fix blank page crash after deployment

requirements.text: Diagnose and fix the blank page issue that occurs after deployment. Audit App.tsx for runtime errors including undefined variable access, failed imports, missing null guards on authentication state, and role-based routing logic that may throw before rendering. Ensure the app renders a visible UI for all authentication states (unauthenticated, loading, authenticated with any role).

quotes: The page is gone blank of this

acceptanceCriteria: The app loads and displays the login page or dashboard without going blank after a fresh deployment
No unhandled JavaScript exceptions are thrown during initial render
All role-based routes (admin, staff, delivery, distributor) render without blank screens
Unauthenticated users see the login page instead of a blank screen
The app recovers gracefully if backend actor initialization is slow or fails

requirements.text: Add a top-level error boundary component wrapping the entire React application in App.tsx to catch and display any unhandled render errors with a user-friendly fallback UI instead of a blank page. The fallback should show the app name and a message indicating an error occurred with a reload button.

quotes: The page is gone blank of this

acceptanceCriteria: A React ErrorBoundary component wraps the top-level app content
When a render error is caught, a fallback UI is displayed instead of a blank page
The fallback UI includes a reload/retry button
The error boundary does not interfere with normal app rendering

requirements.text: Audit all lazy-loaded or dynamically imported components (maps, Leaflet, QR scanner, camera) for missing Suspense boundaries or import failures that could cause a blank render. Wrap all such components with React.Suspense and appropriate loading fallbacks.

quotes: The page is gone blank of this

acceptanceCriteria: All dynamically imported components (SatelliteMapView, QRScanModal, BarcodeScanStep) have Suspense boundaries with loading indicators
A failure to load a dynamic component does not blank out the entire page
Loading states are visible while async components initialize

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Do not change the backend schema or data model
nonGoals: Changing the visual design or color theme
